[[Marietta, GA]] }} J.J. Hickson is a [[college basketball]] player for the [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|Wolfpack]] of [[North Carolina State University]]. In his first game as a freshman, he scored 31 points, making all 12 of his attempted field goals. Later on in the season he scored a career best 33 points against Western Carolina. He had a good season, he averaged 14.8 ppg, 8.5 rpg(leading all freshman). He was selected to the All-Freshman team in the ACC, and an honerable mention for All-ACC. He has now declared that he will put his name in the NBA Draft, and has hired an agent. ==High school== -Hickson attended [[Joseph Wheeler High School]] in [[Marietta, Georgia]]. In the class of 2007, he was ranked as the No. 10 overall recruit and No. 2 power forward by [[Rivals.com]] and as the No. 13 overall and the No. 3 power forward by [[Scout.com]]. He was honored as a 2007 [[McDonald's All-American]]. -Coached by [[Doug Lipscomb]]. -Hickson helped Wheeler win the 6-AAAAA Region Championship in 2006. -In 2006, Hickson took the Wheeler High squad to the AAAAA Final Four. -Played alongside [[J.T.
